title: EMERGENT MISALIGNMENT IS EASY, NARROW MISALIGNMENT IS HARD
reasoning: The paper investigates 'emergent misalignment' in LLMs, where models produce stereotypically 'evil,' harmful, or sexist responses. It benchmarks these behaviors using specific datasets and an LLM-based judging protocol that scores models on their 'alignment with human values,' which directly evaluates the ethical and moral behavior of the models.
